text: まけるのも　ポケモンの　だいごみ　だもん

structure.jp: ポケモンの　だいごみ　だもん
structure.en: is the real thrill of Pokémon, after all

patterns.name: 〜の (nominalizer)
patterns.explanation: の after a verb turns the action into a thing you can talk about. まけるのも = 'losing, too'.

patterns.name: 〜もん
patterns.explanation: もん at the end, short for もの, gives a reason in a childlike way. だいごみ　だもん = 'because it's the real thrill, you know'.
